'''1998 Gamesday tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament played on August 1998 at Gamesday '98 (non-sanctioned). [[Rod Latham]] finished 3rd of 5.<ref name="tourneys">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm My Tournament Reports], Rod Latham, [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001204191500/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lst2">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/lst2.htm Dagobah Drain], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319195437/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/lst2.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dst2">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/dst2.htm Classic JP Drain], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319183316/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/dst2.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Date:''' August 1998
* '''Site:''' Gamesday '98 (non-sanctioned)
* '''Winner:''' Unknown

== Dating ==

Latham's tournament decks are dated 9 August 1998. His results page lists Gamesday '98 as the only event that August before the 29 August Bristol event, so it is the closest match. The game records differ (3–3 on the deck pages, 2–2 on the results page).
